title: Property Rental & Booking Platform
desc: Quick Rent - A rental platform with property listings, bookings, payments, favorites, reviews, authentication, and admin management.
features: Complete Rental Marketplace: Tenants can explore, book, and pay for properties while owners can manage listings and bookings easily.
Secure Role-Based System: JWT authentication with separate access control and dashboards for Tenant, Owner, and Admin users
Complete Booking Workflow: Includes property approval, booking management, Stripe payment integration, transactions, and review system.
Stripe Payment Integration
challenges: Implementing a secure role-based authentication system with different access permissions for Tenant, Owner, and Admin users.
Managing complex booking workflows including property approval, payments, transactions, and review handling.
Integrating Stripe payment functionality while ensuring secure transaction processing and smooth user experience.
futurePlans: Add advanced property recommendation features using AI-based suggestions.
Implement real-time chat between property owners and tenants.
Introduce location-based search with interactive maps and advanced filtering.

title: Pet Adoption Platform
desc: Pet Adoption Platform is a responsive web application built using React.js and Next.js. It allows users to browse and adopt pets from a list of available pets.
features: Secure authentication with JWT, HTTP-only cookies, and protected routes.
Browse pets with search and filtering functionality.
Interactive adoption request system with user dashboard.
Pet owner dashboard for managing pet listings and adoption requests.
Responsive UI with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, dark/light theme, and smooth animations.
challenges: Building a secure adoption request workflow with proper authorization and protected dashboard access.
Implementing efficient search and filtering features for a large number of pet listings.
Managing user, pet owner, and adoption-related data synchronization across the application.
futurePlans: Add online donation and sponsorship features for pets.
Integrate AI-based pet matching recommendations based on user preferences.
Add real-time messaging between adopters and pet owners.

title: Summer Essentials Store
desc: Modern e-commerce application built with Next.js featuring authentication, protected routes, dynamic product listing, user profile management, and responsive UI
features: Full authentication system via BetterAuth supporting Email/Password, Google, and GitHub logins
Dynamic product listing driven by JSON data, featuring a Popular Products section and protected detail views.
Dedicated user profile page allowing logged-in users to view and update their profile details in real time
Fully responsive design built on Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and HeroUI.
challenges: Implementing a complete authentication system with multiple login providers using BetterAuth.
Creating protected product detail pages and managing user profile updates securely.
Designing a responsive e-commerce interface that works smoothly across all devices.
futurePlans: Add shopping cart and complete checkout functionality with payment integration.
Implement product reviews, ratings, and wishlist features.
Add an admin dashboard for product and user management.

title: Weather App
desc: A modern and responsive weather application built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS. Users can search weather by city, view current conditions, hourly and 7-day forecasts, or get weather for their current location using the Browser Geolocation API. Powered by the Open-Meteo API.
features: Real-time weather information with temperature, humidity, wind speed, pressure, feels like temperature, and weather conditions.
Search weather by city name with accurate location-based results and error handling for invalid searches.
Detailed weather forecasts including 24-hour hourly forecast and 7-day daily forecast.
Current location weather detection using Browser Geolocation API with automatic timezone support.
challenges: Handling API integration and displaying accurate weather data from external services.
Implementing browser geolocation functionality with proper permission handling.
Managing different weather states, loading conditions, and error scenarios efficiently.
futurePlans: Add weather alerts and notification features for severe conditions.
Implement weather history tracking and personalized forecasts.
Add weather map visualization with interactive location data.

title: Digital Tools Buying Website
desc: React shopping cart app with real-time cart updates and checkout.
features: Interactive Shopping Cart – Click a product to add it automatically to the cart.
Proceed to Checkout – Clears the cart for a seamless checkout experience.
Dynamic Navbar Count – The cart count updates in real-time when products are added.
Buy Now Feedback – Clicking “Buy Now” displays an Added to cart toast notification.
challenges: Managing real-time cart updates and maintaining accurate product state across components.
Creating a smooth checkout flow with proper user feedback interactions.
Building a responsive shopping interface with reusable React components.
futurePlans: Add backend integration for product and order management.
Implement user authentication and order history features.
Integrate online payment gateway for real purchases.

title: Keep Your Friendships Alive
desc: React app for managing and viewing meaningful personal connections.
features: Component-based architecture – The UI is structured into reusable React components, ensuring better organization, scalability, and maintainability.
Interactive user interface – Uses React state and event handling to create a dynamic and responsive user experience.
Live deployment – Hosted on Netlify for fast and reliable access from any device or browser.
Strengthening debugging and problem-solving skills in React development
challenges: Designing reusable React components while maintaining clean and scalable project structure.
Managing application state and user interactions efficiently.
Creating an engaging user interface that provides a smooth experience.
futurePlans: Add user authentication and personal friendship profiles.
Implement cloud database storage for saving user connections.
Add reminders and notification features to maintain friendships.
